definitions.explanation: The beverage made from roasted coffee beans. Very popular in Japan both hot and iced.

examples.japanese: コーヒーを{飲|の}みませんか。
examples.english: Would you like to drink some coffee?

examples.japanese: ブラックコーヒーをください。
{毎朝|まいあさ}コーヒーを{飲|の}みます。
コーヒーは{熱|あつ}いのと{冷|つめ}たいのとどちらがいいですか。
examples.english: Which do you prefer, hot or cold coffee?

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}と{一緒|いっしょ}にコーヒーを{飲|の}みながら{話|はな}すのが{好|す}きです。
examples.english: I like drinking coffee and chatting with friends.

notes: Japan has a strong coffee culture with many 喫茶店 (kissaten, traditional coffee shops) and modern cafes. Common variations: ブラックコーヒー (black coffee), アイスコーヒー (iced coffee), カフェオレ (cafe au lait). Canned coffee from vending machines is also very popular.
